titular: Mechanical engineer · machine and product design
bio: I am a mechanical engineer. I hold a bachelor’s degree in Industrial Technologies Engineering and a master’s in Industrial Engineering with a mechanical specialisation, both from ETSEIB (UPC), and I spent exchange periods in Finland and Chile.

I have worked in machinery and product design: 3D models, drawings, calculations, prototypes and testing, working closely with the workshop and suppliers. My degrees gave me a grounding in machine element design, strength of materials, materials selection, manufacturing processes, vibration and machine testing, and I have carried out nonlinear finite element analysis.

I have enjoyed making things since I was a child, and that is what I want to keep doing: designing ever more advanced machines, ideally in aerospace, defence, automotive or robotics. In the long term, I would like to lead an R&D department.

items.texto: I designed custom machinery for dams and water treatment plants: self-cleaning bar screens, grit removal travelling bridges, sluice gates and their drive mechanisms. I modelled the machines and produced their drawings in SolidWorks, and prepared the layout drawings in AutoCAD and BricsCAD. I also checked structural strength by calculation and built 3D layouts for new machinery and piping.

I developed a fall-arrest device for suspended platforms. It went through about nine design versions, testing prototypes and refining them with suppliers and the workshop, until it reached production, and it is on sale today. I also trained the technicians who assemble it and designed suspended platforms, including layout drawings for customer sites.
